target_bug_relation: The protected UI-state test opens the Slider sample page, drags the step-tip slider to the right end, and then reads the slider's tip content from the ArkUI inspector tree. On the pre-fix revision the slider value is a fixed literal and the tip content is empty after the drag; on the post-fix revision the value is bound to a @State updated by onChange and the tip content is the runtime value ('90' after the drag), matching the reported fix that keeps the bubble in sync with the stop position. No wall-clock assertions are used.
